digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today brought clearer ownership on the DNC request, but none of the tracked priorities is yet marked complete. The remaining work is concentrated around Amazon Connect readiness, portfolio prioritization, and operating follow-through.

items.label: Close Amazon Connect Round 1 and set the UAT recovery plan
items.detail: Record the Round 1 close and turn the remaining UAT 1.5 questions into owners and dates. Teams also surfaced decisions on blind versus warm transfers and a dedicated Salesforce integration account; keep progress tracking, first-line support, and the September 14 go/no-go path together.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: Rank the five Quality requests by business impact and set one intake path that fits available PM and PE capacity.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Finalize the production list, remaining leaders, provisioning guidance, and alternate caller IDs. Today's Teams discussion identified about 150 users whose fax-linked direct numbers may still require RingCentral, so document that interim scope before Round 2.

items.label: Update the Sprint 17 plan with today's DNC direction
items.detail: Record Biographical Deadlines as deferred and NTA as included. Teams clarified that the DNC request is to remove the automation, with Ben serving as both the main contact and tester; place the work in the Sprint 18 path because Sprint 17 has already started.

items.label: Finish and send Sara the August hours report
items.detail: Include each team member's Rippling hours plus August PTO and holiday totals. Teams confirms those categories were added; finish the final delivery to Sara.

items.label: Limpiar Asana con el spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Reconcile Armando's spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view for tomorrow's 1:1.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and permission level for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: Confirm the Revenue Cloud owner, bring Deepak and Tim into the Sales Cloud work, secure an invoice record in sandbox, and set firm due dates.

items.label: Close out the Staff Aug document question
items.detail: Confirm that Licelot has the intended access path and knows whether any action remains after the accidental broad sharing invitation.

items.label: Legal Initial Project Portfolio Review was cancelled
items.detail: Outlook sent an explicit cancellation for today's 3:30 PM review.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Standup, Toggl touchpoint, and Armando 1:1
items.detail: Three back-to-back meetings leave no transition time; bring the UAT closeout and cleaned operating view into the sequence.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Amazon Connect sync followed by protected work time
items.detail: Use the project sync to convert today's Round 1 status into owners and dates, then protect the 90-minute block for follow-through.

items.label: 2:00-5:00 PM - Firmwide meeting, Laura and Thiago 1:1s, and Tudo Bem
items.detail: The afternoon runs continuously from the firmwide meeting through the rescheduled 3:30 PM Thiago 1:1 and the 4:00 PM weekly team meeting.
